cases.question: How many days of paid time off do employees receive each year?
cases.answer:
Great question! Here's what the handbook says about paid time off:

**Paid Time Off (PTO): 15 days per year, accrued monthly.**

A few additional details from the same Leave & Time-Off section that you may find helpful:

- **Sick Leave:** 5 days per year, non-cumulative
- **Parental Leave:** 12 weeks paid leave following the birth or adoption of a child
- **Holidays:** 10 paid public holidays observed by the company

Note that all leave must be requested in advance through the HR portal, except in emergency situations.

If you have questions about your specific balance or enrollment, you can reach out to HR at hr@acmetech.com or (555) 123-4567. For details on other benefits, see the [Employee Benefits Overview](https://acmetech.com/handbook/benefits) or the [Leave & Time-Off Policies](https://acmetech.com/handbook/leave-policies) section of the handbook.

cases.question: How many sick leave days do employees receive each year?
cases.answer:
**Sick Leave: 5 days per year** — this leave is **non-cumulative**, meaning unused days don't carry over to the following year.

A quick note on how it fits with other time off outlined in the handbook's Leave & Time-Off Policies:

| Leave Type | Amount |
|---|---|
| Paid Time Off (PTO) | 15 days per year, accrued monthly |
| Sick Leave | 5 days per year, non-cumulative |
| Parental Leave | 12 weeks paid, following birth or adoption |
| Holidays | 10 paid public holidays |

All leave must be requested in advance through the HR portal, except in emergency situations. If you're unable to attend work due to illness, you should also notify your supervisor as early as possible.

Source: [AcmeTech Employee Handbook](./data/AcmeTech_Employee_Handbook.pdf)

For questions about your specific balance or enrollment details, you can reach HR at hr@acmetech.com or (555) 123-4567.

cases.question: How much paid parental leave do employees receive?
cases.answer:

According to the AcmeTech Employee Handbook, employees receive **12 weeks of paid leave** following the birth or adoption of a child.

A few related details from the Leave & Time-Off Policies section:

| Leave Type | Entitlement |
|---|---|
| Paid Time Off (PTO) | 15 days per year, accrued monthly |
| Sick Leave | 5 days per year, non-cumulative |
| **Parental Leave** | **12 weeks paid** (birth or adoption) |
| Holidays | 10 paid public holidays |

Please note that all leave must be requested in advance through the HR portal, except in emergency situations.

If you have questions about eligibility or need help submitting a request, you can reach HR at hr@acmetech.com or (555) 123-4567.

Source: AcmeTech Employee Handbook — Leave & Time-Off Policies and Employee Benefits Overview sections.

cases.question: How is paid time off accrued?
cases.answer:
Here's what the AcmeTech Employee Handbook says about paid time off:

**Paid Time Off (PTO):** Employees receive **15 days per year, accrued monthly**. This means you build up PTO gradually over the course of the year rather than receiving the full allotment up front.

A few related details from the Leave & Time-Off Policies section:
- **Sick Leave:** 5 days per year (non-cumulative)
- **Parental Leave:** 12 weeks paid leave following the birth or adoption of a child
- **Holidays:** 10 paid public holidays observed by the company

All leave must be requested in advance through the HR portal, except in emergency situations.

For more details, you can reach HR at hr@acmetech.com or (555) 123-4567.

Source: [AcmeTech Employee Handbook](./data/AcmeTech_Employee_Handbook.pdf)

cases.question: Where should employees submit leave requests?
cases.answer:
**Employees should submit leave requests through the HR portal.** According to the handbook, all leave must be requested **in advance through the HR portal**, except in emergency situations.

A few related details to keep in mind:

- **PTO:** 15 days per year, accrued monthly
- **Sick Leave:** 5 days per year, non-cumulative
- **Parental Leave:** 12 weeks paid leave following the birth or adoption of a child
- **Holidays:** 10 paid public holidays observed by the company

If you're absent due to illness or an emergency, notify your supervisor as early as possible. And for any questions about your leave, you can reach HR at **hr@acmetech.com** or **(555) 123-4567**.

Source: [AcmeTech Employee Handbook](./data/AcmeTech_Employee_Handbook.pdf)
